name: Lint and Test
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [ develop ]
jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
      - run: pip install flake8 black pytest
      - run: pip install -r requirements.txt
      - run: flake8 src/ tests/
      - run: black --check src/ tests/
      - run: pytest tests/
